description: Pinned engine binary (Windows) for No Cache Browser. Product is the NCB host — we do not ship or default to a system browser binary.
notes: Resolve order (same bar as Linux): EngineStartConfig.enginePath → NCB_ENGINE_PATH → bundled third_party/engine-binary/engine.exe.
System engine binary ONLY when NCB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ENGINE=1|true.
Fetch/install script and process lifecycle glue are TBD — this pin + resolveWindowsEnginePath are the stub matching Linux pattern.
Upstream download metadata will be base64-encoded here so the repo stays free of banned vendor substrings.
Mac is out of product scope.
